Rollout sequence revised per user direction 2026-07-18 (plan: warm-crafting-dragon.md §Rollout). Fleet pre-staging now runs through cc-guides, not a direct-edit sweep:

R1a cc-guides declarative kinds registry (Spec per kind: Append|Merge strategy, marker syntax, official cgo tree-sitter syntax validation + native semantic hooks; behavior-preserving, lock format + pins-only-diff gate untouched) → R1b TOML kind as a registry entry + fleet byte-parity harness + zig-CGO goreleaser + per-platform smoke, cc-guides release BEFORE any fleet render → R2 six shared fragments in cc-skills plugin/guides/toml/ (capt-hook-base/python/go/cc-notes/cc-present/ccx; authkit's lone comment dropped per user — zero local fragments fleet-wide) → R3 40-repo render sweep (layout.toml per archetype, tomllib set-compare vs legacy packs.toml, commit+push per repo; deterministic roster gates the tag) → R4 6 pack-source surfaces (cc-context/cc-notes/cc-present/cc-guides dual-grammar hand-authored; getaway plugin release BEFORE its consumer file; show@cc-skills; net-new deps + allowlist for cc-notes+show) → R5 tag v10.0.0 (merge-not-rebase, PyPI-picked) → R6 repo-bootstrap fragment-layout templates, cleanup releases w/ >=10.0.0 floors, legacy packs.toml git-rm sweep after heartbeats.

DO-NOT-TAG gate unchanged: R3 roster complete on origin + R4 dual-grammar loads verified first. Durable win: future fleet-wide pack changes = one shared-fragment edit; daily ci-render crons propagate ≤24h.
